title: LambyOS Setup

balloons.text: Hi! It looks like you're restoring a session. Want a hand?
Want to know what this place is?
Is your sound on? Things sound better with headphones.
You won't need to walk. Just turn!
One more thing before we start.
Want to see our advert first?

about.title: About this project
paragraphs: This is a piece about how organised “conversion” networks (SOGICE) targeted queer people online, from 1997 to 2026. Four updates, thirty years: none of them changed who anyone was.

It is part of SurvivingSOGICE, at the University of Bergen's Center for Digital Narrative, and rests on the project's research and sources: the Lexicon in the Library, at the end, holds the words and the reasons, and the menu's Credits & attributions lists the rest.
It was directed by the project, and written and built in collaboration with Claude (Anthropic).

look.title: How to look
captions: On a computer, drag to look.
On a phone or tablet, turn the device.
In a headset, turn your head.
look.body: The piece will take you wherever you need to be.
look.denied: Motion access was declined — you can still drag to look.
look.unavailable: Device look is unavailable — you can still drag to look.

note.title: CONTENT NOTE
note.body: This depicts how organised “conversion” networks target queer people online — in their own tactics and language. It has brief flashing when a system fails, and a few moments when the view is moved for you between rooms (if your device is set to reduce motion, those become cuts). You can leave at any time; nothing you do is kept.
note.menu: Esc — or the corner button — opens the menu: pause, where you are, controls, credits, leave.
